{{Quote|When Moff Garreter mobilized his fleet to assist Head of State Fel, Moff Woolbam attempted to annex Rimcee Station. Garreter was forced to divert to protect the integrity of his holdings.|A newscaster, during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]]|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
'''Garreter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] and member of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. In [[44 ABY]], during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]], he sided with [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] against [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]. When Garreter sent his fleet to assist Fel at the [[battle over Exodo II]], Moff [[Woolbam]] tried to [[Attack on Rimcee Station|annex]] [[Rimcee Station]]. Garreter was then forced to redirect his forces to protect his territories.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
